Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer


Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.


Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs)


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
5 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:
As a Large Language Model Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate with advanced language models and various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through continuous integration and delivery practices. The engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to enhance the performance and scalability of artificial intelligence solutions, while continuously refining the user experience and operational efficiency of the deployed applications.


Roles Responsibilities:

Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.

Responsible for team decisions.

Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.

Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.

Lead the design and implementation of scalable AI-driven applications that utilize Large Language Models.

Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and technical skill development.

Coordinate with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business objectives.

Drive innovation by researching and integrating emerging technologies relevant to AI and language models.


Professional Technical Skills:


Must To Have Skills:

Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).

Experience in developing and integrating APIs for AI applications.

Strong knowledge of front-end and back-end development frameworks and tools.

Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines.

Ability to optimize AI models and applications for performance and scalability.

Competence in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues in AI systems.

The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).

This position is based at our Pune office.

A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education
